description: This file contains extension methods for managing reminders in Orleans grains, including registering, unregistering, and retrieving reminders, specifically for grains implementing IRemindable.

classes.name: GrainReminderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for reminder management in Orleans grains.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers or updates a persistent reminder for a grain, ensuring it implements IRemindable.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered reminder for a grain.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by name for a grain.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders registered by a grain.
